title: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure

contractDetails.constraints: At most 10,000 calls. Text lengths are 1–25. AddWord takes lowercase English letters. Search takes lowercase letters and at most two dots. Fixture rows are [operation, text]. Search results are 1 or 0 in call order.

statement: Build an initially empty WordDictionary. AddWord stores a literal word. Search tests whether any stored word matches the entire pattern. A dot matches exactly one lowercase letter. Search calls leave stored words unchanged.

examples.explanation: Each dot consumes one letter, so the shorter pattern fails.
Duplicate inserts still store one single-letter word.
The failed wildcard query leaves the word intact.

constraints: At most 10,000 calls. Text lengths are 1–25. AddWord takes lowercase English letters. Search takes lowercase letters and at most two dots. Fixture rows are [operation, text]. Search results are 1 or 0 in call order.
hints: Conceptual: A dot changes the choice at one position, but the total length stays fixed.
Directional: Use a Trie and branch across existing child links at a dot.
Implementation: After the last character require an end-of-word mark. Return true as soon as any branch completes a match.
complexityAnalysis: AddWord takes O(L). Search takes O(L·26ᵈ) time as an upper bound for d dots and O(L) recursive stack space. The Trie stores O(S) distinct prefix nodes.
